Precondition: A sublot LOT created from a parent
Expected Result: The label displays both the sublot's own LotNumber and the ParentLotNumber; the LotLabel row carries a ParentLotId reference

Precondition: A sublot with a known parent
Step: In the genealogy view, enter either the sublot or the parent number
Expected Result: The system resolves and shows the other number; the parent reference is preserved through reprint

Precondition: Any LOT with a printable LTT
Expected Result: A LotLabel row is recorded with LOT, print reason, rendered ZPL content, printer name, printed-by user, terminal, and timestamp

Step: Trigger prints across scenarios (LOT creation, damaged reprint, split, merge, sort-cage re-identify)
Expected Result: Each print records the correct reason code — Initial, ReprintDamaged, Split, Merge, or SortCageReIdentify

Precondition: A completed container with a claimed AIM shipper ID
Expected Result: A ZPL shipping label carries the AIM shipper ID, part number, quantity, and Honda-required fields and is sent to the terminal's Zebra
Every print, void, and reprint is recorded with container, AIM shipper ID, label type, ZPL content, void flag, printed/voided timestamps, and printed-by user
IsVoid=1 and VoidedAt are set, the row is retained (not deleted), and AIM is notified of the void

Step: Re-pack the container and close the new container
Expected Result: The voided AIM ID is NOT returned to the pool (permanently consumed); the re-packed container draws a fresh ID from the pool

Step: Reprint the label as an authorized user
Expected Result: A NEW ShippingLabel row is created (Initial=0 with a print reason); the original row is unchanged

Precondition: A pool pre-fetched with AIM shipper IDs for the part
Step: Complete containers and inspect the pool
Expected Result: IDs are consumed FIFO (oldest FetchedAt first) at container close; each consumed row is terminal (ConsumedAt set, pointing at the consuming container)

Precondition: An exhausted AIM pool for the part
Step: Attempt to complete a full container
Expected Result: Completion hard-fails before the transaction (container stays Open) and production stops on the line until the pool refills — no soft fallback

Precondition: A completed container placed on hold
Step: Place the container on hold; then release it
Expected Result: AIM PlaceOnHold is called with the shipper ID on hold and ReleaseFromHold on release; both calls are logged to Audit.InterfaceLog
Notes: AIM HTTP endpoint simulated in dev (logs attempt + not-configured status)

Precondition: A Sort Cage re-pack with serial migration
Step: Re-pack a container with new serials
Expected Result: AIM UpdateAim is called with the new and previous serial parameters and logged to Audit.InterfaceLog

Precondition: A terminal with an associated Zebra printer
Step: Print a label from that terminal
Expected Result: ZPL is sent over a TCP socket to the terminal's configured printer; ZPL templates come from configurable LabelTemplate rows, not hard-coded
Notes: Zebra raw-TCP 9100; no networked printer in dev (simulated)

Precondition: A shipping label queued at container close
Step: Force a print failure at the Zebra
Expected Result: Dispatch is async (Gateway-script-async); on failure the handler retries up to 3 attempts with a 2s gap, then sets PrintFailedAt and surfaces a terminal banner; a stranded-print sweep catches orphaned labels
Notes: Print-failure lifecycle; dev SIM fails-fast + logs

Expected Result: All four methods are implemented and fire on their triggers — GetNextNumber (pool topup), UpdateAim (Sort Cage re-pack), PlaceOnHold (hold), ReleaseFromHold (release)
Notes: AIM endpoint simulated in dev; live HTTP wiring at commissioning

Step: Trigger an AIM call while the endpoint is unavailable
Expected Result: The failure is logged to Audit.InterfaceLog with error details, queued for retry, the shipping operator is alerted the call is pending, and the container stays in its current status until the call succeeds

Precondition: A pre-fetched AIM pool with AIM offline
Step: Complete containers during an AIM outage
Expected Result: Containers still complete and stage from the pre-fetched pool and production is not blocked by the AIM outage; only a fully exhausted pool stops closure (per the pool hard-fail)

Precondition: Container ready to complete with an assigned printer
Step: Complete a container and observe the label dispatch
Expected Result: The proc commits DB state (ShippingLabel row, PrintedAt NULL) and returns immediately; the print is dispatched async via sendRequestAsync — the operator is not blocked on printer latency
